newsitem.title: FRANCE: All French refineries hit by barricades - ministry.
newsitem.headline: All French refineries hit by barricades - ministry.

text.p: French truckers tightened their barricades against the oil industry to include all the country's refineries on Thursday after talks to end the 11-day haulage strike collapsed, an industry ministry official said.
Roadblocks were spread out in front of all 13 French refineries and more than half the country's 400 fuel depots, the official told Reuters.
On Wednesday, the oil industry put the number of refineries affected at 12 out of 13.
The official said between 1,000 and 1,500 stations were out of petrol, including most in southeastern France.
Local officials in about 40 or nearly half France's departments, or provinces, were carrying out emergency plans to requisition petrol stations for priority vehicles.
About 10 service stations had been commandeered in each of the affected departments, the official said.
A spokeswoman at oil industry association UFIP said she had no further information ahead of a daily crisis meeting scheduled for 1000 GMT.
